Source: .briefs/eval-gap-v2-human-lens.md section 4, authored by Fable (Eval V2 Audit, surface:55). Operator-approved 2026-08-12. Read that section for the full human-problem framing before starting. (V2-7, ~45 min. Small, real, attendee- and judge-facing.)

SEQUENCE AFTER #132 MERGES (MRQ-143, speaker directory) — same files.

1. /speakers gains a Gallery / List toggle, the list being a genuinely distinct compact layout (rows: name, title · company, session count; no photos), reusing the embed's existing list layout. Fixed-width toggle, no jump — DESIGN.md craft rule: elements never jump. (EMB-12, w2 partial — the rubric wants 'a second surface to be distinct from'.)
2. Speaker profile: bio clamps to about 5 lines with a Show more control, and the sessions header becomes 'Sessions (N)'. (EMB-13, w1 partial remainder.)
3. Outbox status chip: 'suppressed · demo mode' becomes 'held in demo outbox · would send in production' (CommsScreen.tsx:378). This is the truth the product already means. (CFP-14, w2 partial.)
4. One line: a manually-closed portal stops printing a FUTURE close date beside 'CLOSED'. Show the closure state's own date, or nothing. (CFP-04 residue.)

VERIFY. Toggle between gallery and list on /speakers with no layout shift; a long bio clamps and expands; the outbox chip reads the new copy; a manually closed portal shows no future date.
data.title: V2-7: public speakers, finished; and honest outbox copy

data.body: Implementation review complete at exact HEAD 532d38a3. MRQ-156 adds the shared public speaker directory view contract, fixed-width Gallery/List toggle, compact rows with session counts and no photos, SSR-open progressive bio, Sessions (N), truthful outbox chip copy with suppressed_reason detail, and closed-portal date suppression. PR #139 is already in base and only supplies surname ordering; the list layout remains this ticket's distinct second surface. Full pr-gate passed (112005ms, exit 0), git diff --check passed, and the worktree is clean.

Running-system validation complete against a real local Cloudflare Worker seeded from the repo. Browser observations: /speakers Gallery and ?view=list switch between a photo-free compact row and gallery cards; list rows show Grace Isford, Partner · Lux Capital, and 2 published sessions; mobile toggle boxes were equal-width and fixed-height; search and clear preserved view/query. /p/grace-isford rendered SSR-open bio markup, clamped the long bio to about five lines, expanded to Show less, and showed Sessions (2). Authenticated /communications rendered held in demo outbox · would send in production and retained demo_mode_not_allowlisted detail. A manually closed /f/cfp rendered Call for speakers · closed with no future close date. The c11 browser surface timed out under fleet contention, so Playwright against the same local Worker supplied the observed browser proof; screenshots were inspected.

provenance.reason: merged to main and deployed to production; verified live by build hash
